Implement the following requested change in the repository.

Region name in ARN is hardcoded to us-east-1 instead of using the provided region

Description

When creating a Pinpoint application in a region other than us-east-1, the ARN incorrectly contains "us-east-1" instead of the actual region used.

For example, when creating an app in eu-west-1:
```python
client = boto3.client('pinpoint', region_name='eu-west-1')
resp = client.create_app(CreateApplicationRequest={'Name': 'myapp'})
app_id = resp['ApplicationResponse']['Id']
resp = client.get_app(ApplicationId=app_id)
```

The ARN in the response contains "us-east-1" instead of "eu-west-1":
```
arn:aws:mobiletargeting:us-east-1:123456789012:apps/abcdef1234567890
```

Expected behavior: The ARN should contain the region that was used to create the application.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: moto/pinpoint/models.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
